title: hedyotis linoides
intro: Hedyotis linoides, commonly known as Wild Moneywort, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis linoides include sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-hypertensive effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents of Hedyotis linoides have been found to possess anti-cancer, anti-microbial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
